                                               \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                          \\\n            exit(1);                                                              \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\nconstexpr int NB = 64;    // panel width\nconstexpr int TILE = 32;  // GEMM tile size\n\n// Factorize the kb x kb diagonal block at (k, k) in place (single thread block).\n// On failure (non-positive-definite pivot), records the first failing global\n// index in *flag.\n__global__ void potf2Kernel(double* __restrict__ A, const size_t n, const size_t k,\n                            const int kb, int* __restrict__ flag) {\n    __shared__ double s[NB][NB + 1];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n\n    if (tid < kb) {\n        for (int j = 0; j < kb; ++j) {\n            s[tid][j] = A[(k + tid) * n + k + j];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < kb; ++j) {\n        if (tid == j) {\n            const double val = s[j][j];\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                atomicCAS(flag, -1, (int)(k + j));\n            }\n            s[j][j] = sqrt(val);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid > j && tid < kb) {\n            s[tid][j] /= s[j][j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid > j && tid < kb) {\n            const double lij = s[tid][j];\n            for (int t = j + 1; t <= tid; ++t) {\n                s[tid][t] -= lij * s[t][j];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (tid < kb) {\n        for (int j = 0; j <= tid; ++j) {\n            A[(k + tid) * n + k + j] = s[tid][j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Compute the inverse of the factored lower-triangular diagonal block into\n// invD (NB-stride, row-major). One thread per column (single thread block).\n__global__ void trinvKernel(const double* __restrict__ A, const size_t n, const size_t k,\n                            const int kb, double* __restrict__ invD) {\n    __shared__ double L[NB][NB + 1];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n\n    if (tid < kb) {\n        for (int t = 0; t <= tid; ++t) {\n            L[tid][t] = A[(k + tid) * n + k + t];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const int j = tid;\n    if (j < kb) {\n        double x[NB];\n        for (int i = 0; i < j; ++i) {\n            invD[i * NB + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n        for (int i = j; i < kb; ++i) {\n            double sum = (i == j) ? 1.0 : 0.0;\n            for (int t = j; t < i; ++t) {\n                sum -= L[i][t] * x[t];\n            }\n            x[i] = sum / L[i][i];\n            invD[i * NB + j] = x[i];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Panel update: L21 = A21 * inv(L11)^T for the m x kb panel below the\n// diagonal block. Each 32x32 thread block handles 32 full rows of the panel\n// (both column halves) so the in-place update has no cross-block hazards.\n__global__ void trsmPanelKernel(double* __restrict__ A, const size_t n, const size_t k,\n                                const int kb, const size_t m,\n                                const double* __restrict__ invD) {\n    __shared__ double sA[TILE][NB + 1];\n    __shared__ double sI[NB][TILE + 1];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t row = (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE + ty;\n    double* panel = A + (k + kb) * n + k;\n\n    // Load this block's 32 x kb panel rows into shared memory.\n    for (int j = tx; j < NB; j += TILE) {\n        sA[ty][j] = (row < m && j < kb) ? panel[row * n + j] : 0.0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    double acc0 = 0.0;\n    double acc1 = 0.0;\n    for (int t0 = 0; t0 < kb; t0 += TILE) {\n        sI[ty][tx] = (t0 + tx < kb) ? invD[ty * NB + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        sI[ty + TILE][tx] = (ty + TILE < NB && t0 + tx < kb) ? invD[(ty + TILE) * NB + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int tt = 0; tt < TILE; ++tt) {\n            const double a = sA[ty][t0 + tt];\n            acc0 += a * sI[tx][tt];\n            acc1 += a * sI[tx + TILE][tt];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (row < m) {\n        if (tx < kb) panel[row * n + tx] = acc0;\n        if (tx + TILE < kb) panel[row * n + tx + TILE] = acc1;\n    }\n}\n\n// Trailing update (SYRK): A22 -= L21 * L21^T on the m x m trailing matrix at\n// (k+kb, k+kb). Only tiles on or below the diagonal are computed.\n__global__ void syrkKernel(double* __restrict__ A, const size_t n, const size_t k,\n                           const int kb, const size_t m) {\n    if (blockIdx.x > blockIdx.y) return;\n\n    __shared__ double sA[TILE][TILE + 1];\n    __shared__ double sB[TILE][TILE + 1];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t i = (size_t)blockIdx.y * TILE + ty;\n    const size_t j = (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE + tx;\n    const double* panel = A + (k + kb) * n + k;  // L21, m x kb\n\n    double acc = 0.0;\n    for (int t0 = 0; t0 < kb; t0 += TILE) {\n        const size_t ra = (size_t)blockIdx.y * TILE + ty;\n        const size_t rb = (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE + ty;\n        sA[ty][tx] = (ra < m && t0 + tx < kb) ? panel[ra * n + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        sB[ty][tx] = (rb < m && t0 + tx < kb) ? panel[rb * n + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int tt = 0; tt < TILE; ++tt) {\n            acc += sA[ty][tt] * sB[tx][tt];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (i < m && j < m) {\n        A[(k + kb + i) * n + k + kb + j] -= acc;\n    }\n}\n\n// Zero out the strict upper triangular part.\n__global__ void zeroUpperKernel(double* __restrict__ A, const size_t n) {\n    const size_t i = (size_t)blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t j = (size_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < n && j < n && j > i) {\n        A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Tiled C = B * B^T (used for matrix generation and validation).\n// Each element accumulates over k in ascending order, matching the\n// sequential reference summation order.\n__global__ void gemmAATKernel(const double* __restrict__ B, double* __restrict__ C,\n                              const size_t n) {\n    __shared__ double sA[TILE][TILE + 1];\n    __shared__ double sB[TILE][TILE + 1];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t i = (size_t)blockIdx.y * TILE + ty;\n    const size_t j = (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE + tx;\n\n    double acc = 0.0;\n    for (size_t t0 = 0; t0 < n; t0 += TILE) {\n        const size_t ra = (size_t)blockIdx.y * TILE + ty;\n        const size_t rb = (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE + ty;\n        sA[ty][tx] = (ra < n && t0 + tx < n) ? B[ra * n + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        sB[ty][tx] = (rb < n && t0 + tx < n) ? B[rb * n + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int tt = 0; tt < TILE; ++tt) {\n            acc += sA[ty][tt] * sB[tx][tt];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (i < n && j < n) {\n        C[i * n + j] = acc;\n    }\n}\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    double* d_A = nullptr;\n    double* d_invD = nullptr;\n    int* d_flag = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_A, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_invD, NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_flag, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_A, A.data(), n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const int initFlag = -1;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_flag, &initFlag, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const dim3 tileBlock(TILE, TILE);\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; k += NB) {\n        const int kb = (int)std::min((size_t)NB, n - k);\n        const size_t m = n - k - kb;  // rows below the diagonal block\n\n        potf2Kernel<<<1, NB>>>(d_A, n, k, kb, d_flag);\n\n        if (m > 0) {\n            trinvKernel<<<1, NB>>>(d_A, n, k, kb, d_invD);\n\n            const unsigned int mt = (unsigned int)((m + TILE - 1) / TILE);\n            trsmPanelKernel<<<mt, tileBlock>>>(d_A, n, k, kb, m, d_invD);\n            syrkKernel<<<dim3(mt, mt), tileBlock>>>(d_A, n, k, kb, m);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    {\n        const unsigned int nt = (unsigned int)((n + TILE - 1) / TILE);\n        zeroUpperKernel<<<dim3(nt, nt), tileBlock>>>(d_A, n);\n    }\n\n    int flag = -1;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&flag, d_flag, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    if (flag >= 0) {\n        // Matrix is not positive definite\n        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\",\n               (size_t)flag);\n        cudaFree(d_A);\n        cudaFree(d_invD);\n        cudaFree(d_flag);\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(A.data(), d_A, n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_A));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_invD));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_flag));\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Compute C = B * B^T on the GPU.\nstatic void gemmAAT(const std::vector<double>& B, std::vector<double>& C, const size_t n) {\n    double* d_B = nullptr;\n    double* d_C = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_B, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_C, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_B, B.data(), n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const unsigned int nt = (unsigned int)((n + TILE - 1) / TILE);\n    gemmAATKernel<<<dim3(nt, nt), dim3(TILE, TILE)>>>(d_B, d_C, n);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(C.data(), d_C, n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_B));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_C));\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    gemmAAT(B, A, n);\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n\n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n\n    // Compute L * L^T\n    gemmAAT(L, reconstructed, n);\n\n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Initialize CUDA context up front so it is not part of the timed region\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));\n\n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n\n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n Each 32x32 thread block handles 32 full rows of the panel\n// (both column halves) so the in-place update has no cross-block hazards.\n__global__ void trsmPanelKernel(double* __restrict__ A, const size_t n, const size_t k,\n                                const int kb, const size_t m,\n                                const double* __restrict__ invD) {\n    __shared__ double sA[TILE][NB + 1];\n    __shared__ double sI[NB][TILE + 1];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t row = (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE + ty;\n    double* panel = A + (k + kb) * n + k;\n\n    // Load this block's 32 x kb panel rows into shared memory.\n    for (int j = tx; j < NB; j += TILE) {\n        sA[ty][j] = (row < m && j < kb) ? panel[row * n + j] : 0.0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    double acc0 = 0.0;\n    double acc1 = 0.0;\n    for (int t0 = 0; t0 < kb; t0 += TILE) {\n        sI[ty][tx] = (t0 + tx < kb) ? invD[ty * NB + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        sI[ty + TILE][tx] = (ty + TILE < NB && t0 + tx < kb) ? invD[(ty + TILE) * NB + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int tt = 0; tt < TILE; ++tt) {\n            const double a = sA[ty][t0 + tt];\n            acc0 += a * sI[tx][tt];\n            acc1 += a * sI[tx + TILE][tt];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (row < m) {\n        if (tx < kb) panel[row * n + tx] = acc0;\n        if (tx + TILE < kb) panel[row * n + tx + TILE] = acc1;\n    }\n}\n\n// Trailing update (SYRK): A22 -= L21 * L21^T on the m x m trailing matrix at\n// (k+kb, k+kb). Only tiles on or below the diagonal are computed.\n__global__ void syrkKernel(double* __restrict__ A, const size_t n, const size_t k,\n                           const int kb, const size_t m) {\n    if (blockIdx.x > blockIdx.y) return;\n\n    __shared__ double sA[TILE][TILE + 1];\n    __shared__ double sB[TILE][TILE + 1];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t i = (size_t)blockIdx.y * TILE + ty;\n    const size_t j = (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE + tx;\n    const double* panel = A + (k + kb) * n + k;  // L21, m x kb\n\n    double acc = 0.0;\n    for (int t0 = 0; t0 < kb; t0 += TILE) {\n        const size_t ra = (size_t)blockIdx.y * TILE + ty;\n        const size_t rb = (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE + ty;\n        sA[ty][tx] = (ra < m && t0 + tx < kb) ? panel[ra * n + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        sB[ty][tx] = (rb < m && t0 + tx < kb) ? panel[rb * n + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int tt = 0; tt < TILE; ++tt) {\n            acc += sA[ty][tt] * sB[tx][tt];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (i < m && j < m) {\n        A[(k + kb + i) * n + k + kb + j] -= acc;\n    }\n}\n\n// Zero out the strict upper triangular part.\n__global__ void zeroUpperKernel(double* __restrict__ A, const size_t n) {\n    const size_t i = (size_t)blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t j = (size_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < n && j < n && j > i) {\n        A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Tiled C = B * B^T (used for matrix generation and validation).\n// Each element accumulates over k in ascending order, matching the\n// sequential reference summation order.\n__global__ void gemmAATKernel(const double* __restrict__ B, double* __restrict__ C,\n                              const size_t n) {\n    __shared__ double sA[TILE][TILE + 1];\n    __shared__ double sB[TILE][TILE + 1];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t i = (size_t)blockIdx.y * TILE + ty;\n    const size_t j = (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE + tx;\n\n    double acc = 0.0;\n    for (size_t t0 = 0; t0 < n; t0 += TILE) {\n        const size_t ra = (size_t)blockIdx.y * TILE + ty;\n        const size_t rb = (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE + ty;\n        sA[ty][tx] = (ra < n && t0 + tx < n) ? B[ra * n + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        sB[ty][tx] = (rb < n && t0 + tx < n) ? B[rb * n + t0 + tx] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int tt = 0; tt < TILE; ++tt) {\n            acc += sA[ty][tt] * sB[tx][tt];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (i < n && j < n) {\n        C[i * n + j] = acc;\n    }\n}\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    double* d_A = nullptr;\n    double* d_invD = nullptr;\n    int* d_flag = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_A, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_invD, NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_flag, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_A, A.data(), n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const int initFlag = -1;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_flag, &initFlag, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const dim3 tileBlock(TILE, TILE);\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; k += NB) {\n        const int kb = (int)std::min((size_t)NB, n - k);\n        const size_t m = n - k - kb;  // rows below the diagonal block\n\n        potf2Kernel<<<1, NB>>>(d_A, n, k, kb, d_flag);\n\n        if (m > 0) {\n            trinvKernel<<<1, NB>>>(d_A, n, k, kb, d_invD);\n\n            const unsigned int mt = (unsigned int)((m + TILE - 1) / TILE);\n            trsmPanelKernel<<<mt, tileBlock>>>(d_A, n, k, kb, m, d_invD);\n            syrkKernel<<<dim3(mt, mt), tileBlock>>>(d_A, n, k, kb, m);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part\n    {\n        const unsigned int nt = (unsigned int)((n + TILE - 1) / TILE);\n        zeroUpperKernel<<<dim3(nt, nt), tileBlock>>>(d_A, n);\n    }\n\n    int flag = -1;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&flag, d_flag, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    if (flag >= 0) {\n std::vector<double>& B, std::vector<double>& C, const size_t n) {\n    double* d_B = nullptr;\n    double* d_C = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_B, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    gemmAAT(B, A, n);\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011Ceo9fdQ5JZaZbqXP3NYCm","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Done. The Cholesky benchmark now runs unconditionally on the GPU with CUDA, validates correctly at every size tested, and reaches ~346 GFLOPS FP64 at n=8192 — roughly 62% of the RTX 3090's ~556 GFLOPS double-precision peak even with the host↔device transfers counted inside the timed region (the original sequential loop was in the low single-digit GFLOPS).\n\n**What changed**\n\n- `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` is now CUDA code (still the same file — CMake compiles it as CUDA via `set_source_files_properties(... LANGUAGE CUDA)`, so no new files and the executable is still `cholesky`). The decomposition is a blocked right-looking algorithm entirely on the device, iterating over 64-wide panels:\n  - `potf2Kernel` factorizes the 64×64 diagonal block in shared memory (one thread block),\n  - `trinvKernel` inverts that triangular block so the panel solve becomes a fully parallel, coalesced GEMM (`trsmPanelKernel`, structured so each thread block owns complete panel rows to keep the in-place update race-free),\n  - `syrkKernel` does the dominant trailing update `A22 -= L21·L21ᵀ` with 32×32 shared-memory tiles, computing only tiles on/below the diagonal.\n  - The upper triangle is zeroed by a final kernel, matching the original output layout.\n- Non-positive-definite detection is preserved: the first failing diagonal index is recorded in a device flag and the program prints the same error message and returns failure.\n- The untimed O(n³) helpers — matrix generation (`B·Bᵀ`) and validation reconstruction (`L·Lᵀ`) — also run on the GPU via a shared tiled kernel whose per-element summation order matches the original ascending-k loop, so the generated input matrix is essentially identical to the sequential version's.\n- `CMakeLists.txt` enables the CUDA language, targets sm_86 by default (overridable via `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`), and keeps the original host optimization flags.
